set.body: Compare ScalaFIM PairingDesign plus identity/fixed certified precision with RSA Toolbox distanceLDC and rsatoolbox calc_rdm_crossnobis on balanced independent runs. Check channel normalization, fixed precision localization, ordered pair reduction, negative null estimates, partition reversal, feature reorder, dense/operator parity, and failure of invalid precision or independence claims.
set.title: C3: reproduce crossvalidated distance and crossnobis against RSA toolboxes
